unit: create-in-observed456 r1 create a private file in an observed private directory

requiredFindings.title: An invalid name is refused only after a native parent capture and its charge
requiredFindings.detail: create_private_file_in_observed_directory observes the parent before any name check; the check runs only inside create_private_regular_file. Measured: all six invalid names ('', '.', '..', 'a/b', 'a\\b', 'a\\0b') cost a full parent capture (one fgetattrlist, charged (1, 131, 7940)) before Name, where the direct creator charges (0, 0, 0); under a non-private parent an invalid name reports Access(AclNotReturned) instead of Name. This breaks the creators' existing, tested 'Name before any charge' property (the directory creator's name test was added at 454 r2 for this reason) and the codebase convention that an invalid request is refused before native I/O (native_session_invalid_request_precedes_native_io, directory_provers_wrong_root_component_refuses_before_any_budgeted_io, native_leaf_request_bounds_precede_open_and_allocation).
requiredFindings.fix: Validate name before the parent observation, preferably through one shared single-component check in private_access.rs rather than a third copy of the condition; add a test that bad names return Name with a zero charge through this function. Reviewer variant F1 does exactly this: it passes the owner test and the probe then shows Name with zero charge in every case, including under a non-private parent.

observations.summary: as_file widens RetainedDirectory: the retained handle was reachable only through platform methods; &File also exposes try_clone (a duplicate descriptor outliving the retention), set_permissions and raw-descriptor access. A narrower shape would keep the handle inside the platform (e.g. a RetainedDirectory method for the accounted ACL capture, or an observation taking &RetainedDirectory). Design note; the current caller only reads.

Observation-to-creation window: the parent is judged at capture time and the file is created through the same retained descriptor (same directory object, no path race). Only the owner or root can later change the parent's mode or ACL, since the observation established no foreign grants; an inheritable foreign ACE added in the window would still be refused by the child's own predicate (residual file, as documented for the creator).
The full security suite still needs a custody-safe TMPDIR; failures identical on base and candidate.
Unused From impls and nested WorkFailure inside Capture/Append.
